facts.text: I enjoy doing knitting in my free time.
I think my knitting hobby has many benefits.
I believe my knitting hobby is not just a time-waster.
I believe my knitting hobby is good for my mental health.
I enjoy creating something with my own two hands through knitting.
I love giving my knitted creations as gifts to friends and family.
When I knit, I tend to forget about everything else going on in my life.
When I knit, I focus on the present moment.
For me, knitting is like a form of meditation.
